routines.name: Monday report
routines.description: Sums last week's sales into a one-page report.

routines.name: broken
routines.problem: it must start with a line of three dashes (---)

drafts.name: Invoice folder
drafts.recipe:
---
name: Invoice folder
schedule:
paused: no
version: 1
inputs:
  - name: month
    ask: Which month?
    default: last month
apps: [Finder]
---

## Steps

1. Move this month's invoices from Downloads into Invoices.
   Check: Downloads has no invoice left.
2. Rename each one to its date and sender.
